note: ONE source of trigger patterns for the evaluation->obligation compiler. Read by modules/daif/turn_obligations.py (Python) and by the E3 Stop hook (Node). Regexes use only syntax common to Python re and JS RegExp; flags are the letters i/u only. scope=table_row applies to lines starting with '|'; scope=sentence applies to the other lines split on sentence ends. The first matching pattern in list order wins per line/sentence. A sentence also refused by the extractor's wish clause, or lacking a commitment frame when frame=true, is dropped. 'exclude' vetoes a match (zero counts are not failures).

patterns.next_action: Fix the failing check and re-run its gate: {text}
Resolve the warning and re-run its gate: {text}
Write the missing evidence file and run its gate: {text}
Commit the changes in the working tree: {text}
Do the stated next step now: {text}

recommendation_stop.note: closer-guard RECOMMENDATION_STOP (E4). A closing sentence matching 'triggers' (or the next_step pattern above AND 'next_step_verb') recommends or defers work the agent could do itself. Vetoed when the closing tail matches 'owner_exclude' (a named Owner category or Owner-directed ask) or 'handoff_exclude' (the HANDOFF BLOCK contract). Read by hooks/closer-guard.js; not a compiler pattern.
